answer: Commit a receipt hash, reveal it one epoch later, let 5 peers score it. Majority with dilution: 5 matches pay 100 percent, 4 pay 60, 3 pay 25, fewer pay 0. No identity may score its own recruit, checked against the join memo. Honest baseline is 2 receipts, 10 peer reads, 0 flags per seat. A 500-seat farm needs 2,500 reads from outside its own karst and cannot supply them, so the jetty it builds stays closed. The stake is the basalt under the scheme: 1 POA per reveal, and at 500 seats that bill lands before any payout clears.
